svg.title: Bangkok, Seoul and Viet Nam master-plan route
svg.desc: The working route from Bangkok to Seoul and Da Nang, returning to Bangkok after the Thai visa is issued. A secondary line marks the Viet Nam road fallback from Da Nang to Ho Chi Minh City.

g.text: ASIA LEG — ROUTES OUT OF BANGKOK
Via Seoul — Korean Air fallback (~11 h)
